methodology.Fees: Taker fees computed as Θ × C × p × (1 - p), where C is contracts and p is trade price. Θ = 0.0695 from 11:59 PM ET 2026-09-16, Θ = 0.06 from 12:00 AM ET 2026-07-01, Θ = 0.05 from 2026-04-04, flat 1% from 2026-01-09 to 2026-04-03. Table Tennis markets pay Θ = 0.10 from 10:00 AM ET 2026-10-07 until 1:00 PM ET 2026-11-06. From 1:00 PM ET 2026-11-06 Θ is set per account by trailing 30-day taker volume (0.095 below $10k down to 0.0695 at $250k+); the public trade files carry no account, so the lowest tier (0.0695) is applied to every trade and fees from that date are a lower bound. Combo trades (launched 2026-08-11) use the same formula until 11:59 PM ET 2026-09-24, then pay C × p × [Θ × (1 - p) + k × (1 - p)^4], with k = 0.04, raised to 0.06 from 10:00 AM ET 2026-10-01, to 0.085 from 10:00 PM ET 2026-10-28 and back to 0.06 from 1:00 PM ET 2026-11-11. Revenue breakdowns are not available due to lack of per-trader volume data.
methodology.UserFees: Taker fees paid by users, computed as Θ × C × p × (1 - p), where C is contracts and p is trade price. Θ = 0.0695 from 11:59 PM ET 2026-09-16, Θ = 0.06 from 12:00 AM ET 2026-07-01, Θ = 0.05 from 2026-04-04, flat 1% from 2026-01-09 to 2026-04-03. Table Tennis markets pay Θ = 0.10 from 10:00 AM ET 2026-10-07 until 1:00 PM ET 2026-11-06. From 1:00 PM ET 2026-11-06 Θ is set per account by trailing 30-day taker volume (0.095 below $10k down to 0.0695 at $250k+); the public trade files carry no account, so the lowest tier (0.0695) is applied to every trade and fees from that date are a lower bound. Combo trades (launched 2026-08-11) use the same formula until 11:59 PM ET 2026-09-24, then pay C × p × [Θ × (1 - p) + k × (1 - p)^4], with k = 0.04, raised to 0.06 from 10:00 AM ET 2026-10-01, to 0.085 from 10:00 PM ET 2026-10-28 and back to 0.06 from 1:00 PM ET 2026-11-11. Revenue breakdowns are not available due to lack of per-trader volume data.
